frontier_id_note: Stable pre-control26 frontier identifier retained for identity only; acceptance is evaluated under root control revision 26 and restored Phase-1-v4 semantics.

frozen_authority.postfreeze_head_movement_assessment: Main moved after semantic freeze, but root blob, role-config blob, and own LATEST blob were repeatedly re-read and remained byte-identical; movement was treated as unrelated transport concurrency per control26 post-freeze rule.

public_sources.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
public_sources.mechanism_used: Task feedback is converted into linguistic self-reflection retained in episodic memory and used to guide later attempts without parameter-weight updates.

public_sources.title: noahshinn/reflexion
public_sources.mechanism_used: Reference experiments use iterative attempts plus persisted self-reflection; the published setup requires Python dependencies and an OpenAI API key for some runs, and the repository explicitly notes API access/charges as a rerun constraint.

distinctness_check.result: No prior own Reflexion binding was found by the role-local repository searches performed before this audit.
distinctness_check.claim_scope: This is a role-local distinctness check, not proof of global novelty.

literal_runtime_assessment.reason: The reference implementation depends on task runtimes, Python dependencies and, for published runs, external model/API access. Those dependencies cannot be required by a Phase-1-v4 accepted route.

chat_native_reduction.mechanism: Use terminal role-local evidence as the feedback signal; produce a bounded verbal reflection over that evidence; store only an immutable role-local repair note; resume the same sealed candidate on restart; and allow the reflection to influence only the mutable assignment-strategy layer before the next independently evidenced attempt.

zero_dependency_zero_quota_assessment.repository_transport_role: Lightweight durable state/evidence transport only; rate limits are mechanical and must checkpoint/backoff rather than become semantic compute or failure credit.

constructed_conformance.implementation: Deterministic transition-table evaluation performed inside the recurring scheduled-Chat reasoning path; no external executor, model API, hosted runner or quota-bearing compute used for the tested controller semantics.

exact_scope_result.supported_claim: A bounded Reflexion-style verbal-feedback memory mechanism can be reduced to the sealed critique_search leaf in recurring Chat while preserving restart identity, evidence-before-reflection/credit, CLEAN and authority boundaries, strict Phase-1-v4 zero-residual/zero-quota acceptance, and deterministic switch-on-no-progress on the 12 constructed guards.
unsupported_claims: No claim that the Reflexion paper benchmarks were reproduced.
No claim that Reflexion is superior to other optimizer families on real workloads.
No claim that the literal Python/API implementation is a Phase-1-v4 accepted route.
No claim of global Phase-1 completion.
